solveSteps:
- $0 < x < \pi$일 때: $-\frac{\pi}{2} < x - \frac{\pi}{2} < \frac{\pi}{2}$이므로 $x - \frac{\pi}{2} \le \frac{\pi}{4} \implies 0 < x \le \frac{3}{4}\pi$  
- $\pi < x < 2\pi$일 때: $\frac{\pi}{2} < x - \frac{\pi}{2} < \frac{3\pi}{2}$이므로 $x - \frac{\pi}{2} \le \frac{5\pi}{4} \implies \pi < x \le \frac{7}{4}\pi$  
따라서 해는 $0 < x \le \frac{3}{4}\pi$ 또는 $\pi < x \le \frac{7}{4}\pi$이다.
